content: I can't agree that your argument is airtight until I've seen it. An airtight argument is one that is logically sound, well-reasoned, and does not have any obvious flaws or gaps. Until you present the argument, it's not possible to assess whether it meets these criteria. Please go ahead and share your argument, and I'd be happy to evaluate it.
